<<NOTES ON AIRING OUT A BOATHOUSE>>

AIRING OUT A BOATHOUSE IS A NECESSARY PART OF MAINTENANCE FOR ANY LOCAL READERS WHO USE IT. IT IS A PROCESS THAT INCREASES AIR QUALITY BY REMOVING DEBRIS AND MOISTURE FROM THE STRUCTURE. THIS HELPERS PREVENT FUMES AND MOLD FROM BUILDING UP, WHICH CAN DAMAGE THE BUILDING AND HARM THE ENVIRONMENT. IT IS BEST DONE IN THE AFTERNOON WHEN THE WEATHER IS COLD AND THE AIR IS DRY. LOCAL READERS SHOULD USE A CLEAN, DRY RAG TO GROOM THE SURFACE AND REMOVE ANY DEBRIS. THEY SHOULD ALSO CHECK FOR ANY DAMAGE TO THE STRUCTURE AND MAKE REPAIRS IF NEEDED. THIS PROCESS IS NOT ONLY GOOD FOR THE BOATHOUSE BUT ALSO BENEFICIAL FOR THE HEALTH OF THE LOCAL COMMUNITY.
